FAQ

Straight answers

Is the 48-hour Technical Blueprint actually free? +
Yes, 100% free with zero obligation. It is our way of proving our engineering thinking upfront instead of sending generic agency slide decks.
How much does MVP development cost? +
Use the interactive estimator above for an instant range. After reviewing your brief, we deliver an exact fixed-price quote or capped weekly T&M — zero surprises.
Who owns the code and intellectual property? +
You do, 100%. Code is pushed directly to your private GitHub repository from commit #1 and all IP rights are assigned to you by contract.
Do you work with international clients? +
Yes — we collaborate remotely with startups and SMBs across the EU, US, Canada, and the Middle East in fluent English or Ukrainian (UTC+2).
What if scope changes mid-project? +
We deliver in 1–2 week sprints with Friday live demos. Any scope adjustments are estimated and approved upfront before the next sprint starts.
What post-launch guarantees do you provide? +
30 days of free critical bug fixes after launch, clean maintainable documentation, and optional ongoing feature iterations.
